payout_quote: Official Care.com help article 'How does the caregiver get paid?': 'When you hire a caregiver you find on Care.com, you pay them directly, and in most cases, they will be your household employee.' Also: 'Payment takes place outside of the Care.com platform, using whatever payment method is most convenient for you and your caregiver.' And: 'Caregivers list their desired pay ranges on their profiles, and you can sort and filter caregiver listings by their hourly rate.'
steps: Create a Care.com caregiver profile with a pet care service listing.
List your desired hourly pay range on each pet care service profile.
Apply to pet care job postings or respond to booking requests from families.
Negotiate final rate, schedule, and payment method directly with the family before work starts; families pay you directly outside the Care.com platform.
catches: Rates are self-set and vary by market; there is no guaranteed pay amount or booking volume.
Payment for most jobs happens directly between caregiver and family, outside the Care.com platform — Care.com does not process your pay.
You negotiate everything (rate, hours, duties) yourself; no platform fee cut, but also no payment protection from Care.com.
Competition is high in popular metro areas; a new profile with no reviews gets fewer requests.
biggest_catch: No guaranteed pay and no platform-processed payments: you set your own rates, negotiate directly with families, and they pay you off-platform — earnings depend entirely on landing clients.
eligibility: Anyone able to create a Care.com caregiver profile and offer pet care services; must pass Care.com's screening where required.
timing: Profile setup takes under an hour; paid directly by each family on whatever schedule you negotiate (not via Care.com).
